title: INTRODUCING MAID FOR BLOOD! (vampire survivors with a twist)
author: Maidforblood
selftext:
Hi i am Maid For Blood developer, i used to be a website designer for 4 years, always had a vision to create a game, but never had the time, money or patience to make it a reality, now i can! Welcome to my first and only game project! MAID FOR BLOOD!  you play as a maid, cleaning the manor from left over blood and left over minions your master fought against a powerful foe! (lore is a work in progress)  


CURRENT CONTENT (more will be added as i develop this passion project) :   
Maid skill tree!  
Purchasable upgrades!  
MAID OUTFIT LOOT ON BOSS KILLS (random stats that effect your maid in a run)  
NOW HAS BLOOD PACT THAT CHANGES THE GAME RULES (play it yourself to see them)   
My work flow :  
  
**How I make Maid for Blood: my dev workflow (with AI helpers)**

Some of you have asked how updates get made, so here’s my whole process.

**The team**

* It’s me plus AI coding assistants. Mostly Claude now with opus 5.5 (extra effort) the game was first built with ChatGPT Codex.
* I decide what goes in, make or pick the art, play test everything, and give the final OK.
* The AI writes the code, builds the game, runs the tests and handles Git. I’m honestly still a Git beginner, so having it run Git for me and explain things plainly has been huge.

**Starting a new feature**

* Every idea gets its own separate copy of the project, so experiments never mess with the real game.
* Sometimes I brainstorm first and save the ideas without committing to anything. I’ve got a list of maid skill ideas sitting there right now.

**Test builds**

* Each feature gets its own test build that I can play.
* Before I see it, it runs through about 1,000 automated tests plus about 170 more that run inside the actual game.
* Tests use a separate test profile, so my real save never gets touched.
* I do every play test myself. I want to feel the changes with my own hands.

**Card art**

* I make or find the art, or have the AI write prompts I take to image generators.
* The AI cuts each image into card icons and smaller HUD icons, then checks every cut against the original so no shading gets lost.
* Then it goes into a test build so I can see it in the game.

**Approving changes**

* If the test build feels right, it gets merged into the main version of the game.
* If it doesn’t, it stays on the test copy until it’s fixed.

**Releases**

* Each release gets a version number (we’re on [8.8.85.30](http://8.8.85.30), the Blood Pact update), an in-game patch note, and updated guides.
* Every release gets a written report that only lists the checks that were actually run on that build.
* The release is built fresh from a locked-in, tagged version, so what you download matches the code exactly.
* I get a Windows zip, a source zip and a checksum file, and I upload them to Google Drive.
* [https://drive.google.com/file/d/1w7JZDIBKVB5oTBof9l4Xok7TwmzJu9zO/view?usp=sharing](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1w7JZDIBKVB5oTBof9l4Xok7TwmzJu9zO/view?usp=sharing)
